frozen_forecast.expected_path: No defensible net weekly direction is established. BTC stabilization without broad alt participation, a broader recovery and renewed weakness all remain plausible. falsification_conditions: A persistent joint improvement in BTC and ETH prices, ETH/BTC, broad participation and successive settled flows would resolve the uncertainty toward an upward outlook.
Repeated failed recoveries accompanied by continued ETH/BTC weakness, deteriorating participation and sustained adverse flows would resolve it toward a downward outlook.
A single rebound, isolated ETF inflow or one stronger breadth observation would not by itself resolve the weekly NO_EDGE assessment.
